segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: Are you coming to the picnic?

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: If the weather is good, I'll come.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: If it rains, we'll do it next week.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: By the way, if you heat ice, it melts!

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: If you heat water, it boils.

segments.speaker: Michael
segments.text: If it rains, I'll stay home.
